data.text: Top-center collision facts: Jade (owner config overlayPosX 0.5/PosY 1.0/anchorY 0 = top-center, bossBarOverlapMode PUSH_DOWN) pushes itself below boss bars via BossHealthOverlayMixin capturing height into snownee.jade.util.ClientProxy yOffset; modes HIDE_BOSS_BAR/HIDE_TOOLTIP/NO_OPERATION/PUSH_DOWN. Fancy Toasts does NOT avoid: it hides the boss bar and toggles Jade displayTooltip off while its toast shows. Recommended to owner: toast on top of the top-center column (toast → boss bars → Jade), pushing the others down with eased offsets; needs a small Jade mixin to add our height to yOffset.
